name: Chip supply
summary: Helium shortage from the Gulf war strains chipmakers
state: Qatar supplied a large share of the world's helium, which chip fabs need, and Hormuz disruption plus China's July helium export ban have tightened supply. China's rare-earth export pause expires on 10 Nov. No major TSMC or Samsung output stoppage had been reported as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Electronics prices and lead times could rise if shortages persist.
rubric_hit: New export controls, shortages reported in key segments, or a fab outage.

sources.title: Value Chain Asia — TSMC helium shortage

why: Advanced chips underpin everything from phones to AI to weapons; supply is concentrated in Taiwan and Korea.
drivers: Export controls, Taiwan risk, fab outages, AI demand, materials.

rubric.alert: Major disruption to TSMC/Samsung output, or controls halting a major supply chain.

rubric.normal: Supply normal; no new major controls.
